projectId.description: Filled in for a project budget; `null` for a session one.

policy.description: `block` refuses the call when it would exceed the cap; `allow` lets it through and only warns.

lastThresholdNotified.description: Highest threshold (70/90/100) already notified. It, not the previous spend, serves as the floor — using the spend would make the same warning fire again on every call after it was crossed.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
